description: Links the app in this folder to Ploa, like `ploa init`: an Expo app, or a Flutter, React Native, Capacitor, Android (Gradle) or Xcode app. Finds the app in Ploa by its bundle ID or package name, or adds it with the workspace's App Store and Google Play connections, and writes ploa.json (the app's Ploa ID and server, no secrets; fine to commit). Needs ios.bundleIdentifier or android.package in the Expo config, or an applicationId in Gradle / a bundle ID in the Xcode project. With several connections for a store, name one with apple or google.

apple.description: The App Store connection's name, when there are several.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

google.description: The Google Play connection's name, when there are several.

name: ploa_link
title: Link this folder to Ploa
